subject: Vendor tax docs & EIN signer verification
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: payments@stellaris.bio
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:14:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor tax docs & EIN signer verification

Hi Ahmed / Stellaris accounts team,

Thanks for onboarding with Redwood — excited to get your first invoice processed. Before we can clear payment we need to confirm a few tax and entity details so we can classify the vendor correctly for 1099 and remit purposes. Please provide the following by end of day Friday (Nov 13) so we can include you in the Nov 20 pay run: 

- Completed and signed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if foreign).
- Official EIN verification (IRS CP 575 or EIN confirmation letter) or equivalent documentation.
- Full legal entity name exactly as it appears on IRS records and the name of the authorized signer for tax documents (full name + title).
- Articles of Organization/Incorporation (PDF).
- Confirm whether your entity is classified as a corporation, partnership, sole proprietor, or disregarded entity for US tax purposes (this determines 1099 applicability).
- Upload of bank details to our vendor portal (https://vendor.redwood.example/portal/registrations/9347) or, if you prefer, send a redacted copy here with only routing/account last 4 digits for verification.

If you are a US corporation, note we generally do not issue 1099-MISC/NEC to corporations (exceptions apply for legal services). If you are unsure about classification, please indicate what your tax advisor has you classified as.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment references: we prefer PDFs; you can upload to the portal and reply here once complete.

Entity classification: C Corporation (taxable corporation) — confirmed with our external CPA
Authorized signer for tax matters: Ahmed Rahman, CEO

We have not yet uploaded bank details to your portal; we can do that this morning. For now we have attached a redacted voided check (last 4 digits 4321) and the company Articles of Incorporation. 

Attachments: Stellaris_W9_signed.pdf; EIN_Verification_LETTER_2026-09-02.pdf; Articles_of_Organization.pdf; VOID_check_redacted.pdf

Question: since we are a C-Corp, do you still need any additional tax forms for your records? Also, will Redwood issue a 1099 this year to corporations?

Thanks,
Ahmed Rahman

Stephanie / Laura — quick follow-up from finance after reviewing Ahmed's attachments (thanks Ahmed). A couple of asks before we finalize vendor setup: 

- We need the Articles of Incorporation that clearly show the registered name and jurisdiction (the PDF Ahmed sent looks like an abbreviated summary; can you upload the full certified document?).
- Please confirm that the bank account details uploaded to the portal belong to Stellaris Biotherapeutics, Inc. (last 4 digits 4321 per the redacted voided check). We'll verify micro-deposits as well.
- For our internal compliance: please confirm whether Stellaris has a US tax counsel or CPA on record — a contact name and email is helpful in case we need to confirm classification documentation.

Note on 1099: because Stellaris is a corporation (C-Corp) we typically will not issue a 1099 for the services line items. We still store the W-9 for our records and to support year-end reporting if anything is flagged. If there are any payments that are legal services or other exceptions, we will reach out.

Thanks — Marcus
Manager, Accounts Payable | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
